title: Pair correlation of $αn^θ$ for random $θ$
summary: For fixed $α>0$, we show that the sequence $\{αn^θ\}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for Lebesgue-almost all $θ\in (0,\frac{3}{5})\cup(3,\infty)$. This improves a result of Technau and Yesha, who proved the same for almost all $θ>7$. The approach of Technau and Yesha was based on a repulsion principle, which roughly allows one to estimate the variance of the pair correlation function using the fourth derivative of the phase. In our approach, we split the $θ$-integration in the variance into many short intervals and show that most of the integrals can be estimated using the first derivative.…
